$comment: Sina Una backgrounds, book pp. 198-202 (PDF part 5, pp. 18-22). Chassis: D&D 5e 2014. Personality trait / ideal / bond / flaw tables are omitted — they are flavour text; the app references them by page.

backgrounds.name: Lorechanter
backgrounds.blurb: You have spent your life learning the tales of your people. History is no mere thing to let slip by, but something to be celebrated.
equipment: A token or keepsake from your home village

feature.name: Living Memory
feature.text: You have advantage on all checks to recall histories or legends from or related to your home island.

backgrounds.name: Mangangalakal
backgrounds.blurb: Well versed in trade and worth, skilled in bartering and the social graces it demands. A member of the trade routes that connect one community to another.

feature.name: Shrewd Tongue
feature.text: You have advantage on all checks made to haggle or discern the true value of a good or service.

backgrounds.name: Panday
backgrounds.blurb: A crafter of heightened and dedicated skill. Through years of effort you have honed your craft to a fine degree, and are on the road to total mastery.
equipment: A set of artisan's tools (one of your choice)

feature.name: Skilled Artisan
feature.text: Crafting or repairing something that relates to your specialization requires half the usual cost of materials.

choices.name: Specialization
choices.note: Pandays dedicate their lifetimes to perfecting one particular craft.

backgrounds.flag: Grants three fixed skills where most 5e backgrounds grant two. Recorded as printed.

backgrounds.name: Sea Raider
backgrounds.blurb: Raised to traverse the sea and to fight alongside others. You began sailing when others first learn to farm, and learned the ways of combat at sea.

feature.name: Fearsome Sailor
feature.text: When you make a successful attack against a boat and roll for damage, you can reroll one damage die. You must use the second roll.

backgrounds.name: Voyager
backgrounds.blurb: Your life has known the sea all your life. You may pursue goals upon the shore, but the sea will always call you back home.

feature.name: Uncharted Depths
feature.text: You can hold your breath for a minimum of 5 minutes, regardless of your Constitution modifier.

backgrounds.name: Aswang Lineage
backgrounds.blurb: You were born into a family afflicted with evil. All your life you have lived with the truth that you are related to an aswang.

feature.name: Sinister Visage
feature.text: You have advantage on any check made to terrify or unnerve someone.

choices.name: Embodiment of Wrong
choices.note: Every aswang embodies one of a society's most sinister desires. Choose how your character manifests this nature.

notes: The book states that many traditional 5e backgrounds can be adapted to the setting; these six are the island-specific options.
